+from pathlib import Path
+from collections import Counter
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import stat
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+ROOT = Path('/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall')
+BASE = ROOT / 'artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds'
+ROUND = BASE / 'round149-p6-root-new19-index-null-recovery-20261012'
+R147 = BASE / 'round147-p6-foreign-repository-fixture-lock-recovery-20261012'
+PLAN_SHA = 'b025922cfa547dd8eb9166ff5f01132e2817fdf0a1bcc3d4ad3cdba24adfada3'
+checks = []
+
+
+def record(path):
+    assert isinstance(path, (str, Path)) and str(path)
+    path = Path(path)
+    assert path.is_absolute() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode)
+    data = path.read_bytes()
+    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
+
+
+def check(name, value, detail=None):
+    checks.append({'check': name, 'match': bool(value), 'detail': detail})
+
+
+def verify(pin, field='path'):
+    assert isinstance(pin, dict) and isinstance(pin.get('bytes'), int)
+    assert isinstance(pin.get('sha256'), str) and len(pin['sha256']) == 64
+    actual = record(pin[field])
+    check(field + ' bytes/hash', actual['bytes'] == pin['bytes'] and actual['sha256'] == pin['sha256'], actual)
+    return actual
+
+
+def load(path):
+    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())
+
+
+plan_path = ROUND / 'plan.json'
+assert record(plan_path)['sha256'] == PLAN_SHA
+plan = load(plan_path)
+input_pins = {x['path']: x for x in plan['inputs']}
+assert len(input_pins) == len(plan['inputs']) == 10
+for pin in plan['inputs']:
+    verify(pin)
+index_path = R147 / 'implementation/new19-freeze/source-index.json'
+index = load(index_path)
+schema = plan['schema_observations']
+assert isinstance(index['files'], list) and len(index['files']) == 1208
+assert dict(Counter(x['group'] for x in index['files'])) == schema['groups']
+sole_null = schema['null_source_records'][0]
+null_count = 0
+primary = {}
+for entry in index['files']:
+    verify(entry, 'snapshot')
+    assert entry['snapshot'] not in primary
+    primary[entry['snapshot']] = entry
+    source = entry.get('source')
+    if source is None:
+        assert all(entry.get(k) == sole_null[k] for k in ['group', 'source', 'snapshot', 'bytes', 'sha256'])
+        null_count += 1
+        check('source_not_applicable_generated_report_snapshot_verified', True, entry)
+    else:
+        assert isinstance(source, str) and source
+        verify(entry, 'source')
+assert null_count == 1
+
+
+def subset(entries, expected_count, group):
+    assert isinstance(entries, list) and len(entries) == expected_count
+    for entry in entries:
+        assert entry['group'] == group and primary.get(entry['snapshot']) == entry
+    check('typed primary subset ' + group, True, expected_count)
+
+
+subset(index['sources'], 6, 'current_source')
+subset(index['raw'], 5, 'actual_command_raw')
+subset(index['fixture'], 1192, 'actual_fixture_regular')
+assert isinstance(index['ledgers'], dict) and len(index['ledgers']) == 4
+subset([x['file'] for x in index['ledgers'].values()], 4, 'actual_ledger_snapshot')
+assert len(index['protected']) == 53 and len(index['references']) == 9
+for entry in index['protected'] + index['references']:
+    verify(entry)
+assert len(index['symlink_metadata']) == 7
+for entry in index['symlink_metadata']:
+    path = Path(entry['path'])
+    info = path.lstat()
+    check('symlink metadata nofollow', stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode) and os.readlink(path) == entry['target'] and info.st_mode == entry['mode'] and info.st_size == entry['size'] and info.st_mtime_ns == entry['mtime_ns'], entry)
+
+original_plan = load(R147 / 'plan.json')
+command = original_plan['inherited_new_green19']
+result_entries = [x for x in index['raw'] if Path(x['source']).name == 'result.json']
+assert len(result_entries) == 1
+result = load(result_entries[0]['snapshot'])
+for field in ['argv', 'cwd', 'env', 'evidence_dir']:
+    check('new19 exact ' + field, result[field] == command[field])
+check('actual new19 spent1/0 exit0', result['used'] == 1 and result['remaining'] == 0 and result['exit_code'] == 0)
+for name, pin in result['raw_outputs'].items():
+    entries = [x for x in index['raw'] if Path(x['source']).name == name]
+    assert len(entries) == 1
+    check('actual stream recorded pin ' + name, entries[0]['bytes'] == pin['bytes'] and entries[0]['sha256'] == pin['sha256'])
+
+assert len(index['runs']) == 4
+mapping = {}
+run_summaries = []
+expected_counts = [(20, 19, 1), (1, 1, 0), (19, 19, 0), (1, 1, 0)]
+for run, counts in zip(index['runs'], expected_counts):
+    verify(run['junit'])
+    tree = ET.parse(run['junit']['path'])
+    suites = list(tree.iter('testsuite'))
+    cases = list(tree.iter('testcase'))
+    assert len(suites) == 1
+    passed, failed = set(), set()
+    for case in cases:
+        node = 'tests/test_operational_runtime_closure.py::' + case.get('name')
+        bad = any(child.tag in {'failure', 'error', 'skipped'} for child in case)
+        assert node not in passed and node not in failed
+        (failed if bad else passed).add(node)
+    suite = suites[0].attrib
+    check('actual JUnit counts ' + run['run'], len(cases) == counts[0] and len(passed) == counts[1] and len(failed) == counts[2] and suite['tests'] == str(counts[0]) and suite['failures'] == str(counts[2]) and suite['errors'] == '0' and suite['skipped'] == '0')
+    check('actual JUnit recorded exact nodes ' + run['run'], passed == set(run['passed_nodes']) and failed == set(run['failed_or_nonpass_nodes']))
+    if run['run'] == 'original_new19_19pass':
+        expected = {x for x in command['argv'] if x.startswith('tests/')}
+        check('new19 exact19 unique nodes', len(expected) == 19 and passed == expected and not failed)
+    for node in sorted(passed):
+        mapping.setdefault(node, []).append(run['run'])
+    run_summaries.append({'run': run['run'], 'passed': sorted(passed), 'failed': sorted(failed), 'junit': run['junit']})
+proof_pins = [x for x in index['references'] if x['path'] == str(R147 / 'implementation/delta_proof/proof.json')]
+assert len(proof_pins) == 1
+proof = load(proof_pins[0]['path'])
+check('exact source scope proof', proof['status'] == 'PASS_FOREIGN_FIXTURE_DELTA_SOURCE_ONLY' and proof['other39_nodes_and_three_other_variants_unchanged'] and proof['entire_module_AST_type_comments_equal_after_only_exact_statement_normalization'])
+verify(proof['after'])
+verify(proof['prior_type_proof'])
+check('40unique pass mapping exact', len(mapping) == index['unique_terminal_pass_nodes'] == 40 and mapping == index['terminal_pass_evidence_mapping'] and set(mapping) == set(proof['parameter_values_ids_and40_source_nodeids_unchanged']))
+
+subset(index['lifecycle_files'], 18, 'actual_fixture_regular')
+lifecycle = []
+for entry in index['lifecycle_files']:
+    data = load(entry['snapshot'])
+    check('actual lifecycle session closed', data['session_closed'], entry['source'])
+    check('actual lifecycle raw_exit1/shutdown1', data['calls'].count('raw_exit') == 1 and data['calls'].count('shutdown') == 1, entry['source'])
+    lifecycle.append({'source': entry['source'], 'snapshot': entry['snapshot'], 'calls': data['calls'], 'session_closed': data['session_closed']})
+output = ROUND / 'implementation/reader.json'
+receipt = {'status': 'PASS_SCHEMA_AWARE_NEW19_METADATA' if all(x['match'] for x in checks) else 'STOP_MISMATCH', 'authority': record(index_path), 'checks': checks, 'file_snapshots': 1208, 'present_sources': 1207, 'source_not_applicable': sole_null, 'fixture_regular': 1192, 'symlink_metadata': 7, 'actual_runs': run_summaries, 'terminal_pass_mapping': mapping, 'unique_terminal_pass_nodes': 40, 'single40_run': False, 'actual_lifecycle': lifecycle, 'product_executions': 0, 'old_reader_replay': 0, 'acceptance': False, 'boundary': 'CPU software evidence only. Fresh independent final review still required; no B/C/D/native/physical/actual/formal acceptance.'}
+with output.open('x') as stream:
+    json.dump(receipt, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+    stream.write('\n')
+print(json.dumps({'status': receipt['status'], 'receipt': record(output), 'checks': len(checks), 'mismatches': sum(not x['match'] for x in checks), 'unique_terminal_pass_nodes': 40}, ensure_ascii=False))
+if receipt['status'] != 'PASS_SCHEMA_AWARE_NEW19_METADATA':
+    raise SystemExit(1)

+from pathlib import Path
+from collections import Counter
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import stat
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+
+ROOT = Path('/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall')
+BASE = ROOT / 'artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds'
+ROUND = BASE / 'round149-p6-root-new19-index-null-recovery-20261012'
+R147 = BASE / 'round147-p6-foreign-repository-fixture-lock-recovery-20261012'
+PLAN_SHA = 'b025922cfa547dd8eb9166ff5f01132e2817fdf0a1bcc3d4ad3cdba24adfada3'
+checks = []
+
+
+def record(path):
+    assert isinstance(path, (str, Path)) and str(path)
+    path = Path(path)
+    assert path.is_absolute() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode)
+    data = path.read_bytes()
+    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
+
+
+def check(name, value, detail=None):
+    checks.append({'check': name, 'match': bool(value), 'detail': detail})
+
+
+def verify(pin, field='path'):
+    assert isinstance(pin, dict) and isinstance(pin.get('bytes'), int)
+    assert isinstance(pin.get('sha256'), str) and len(pin['sha256']) == 64
+    actual = record(pin[field])
+    check(field + ' bytes/hash', actual['bytes'] == pin['bytes'] and actual['sha256'] == pin['sha256'], actual)
+    return actual
+
+
+def load(path):
+    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())
+
+
+plan_path = ROUND / 'plan.json'
+assert record(plan_path)['sha256'] == PLAN_SHA
+plan = load(plan_path)
+input_pins = {x['path']: x for x in plan['inputs']}
+assert len(input_pins) == len(plan['inputs']) == 10
+for pin in plan['inputs']:
+    verify(pin)
+index_path = R147 / 'implementation/new19-freeze/source-index.json'
+index = load(index_path)
+schema = plan['schema_observations']
+assert isinstance(index['files'], list) and len(index['files']) == 1208
+assert dict(Counter(x['group'] for x in index['files'])) == schema['groups']
+sole_null = schema['null_source_records'][0]
+null_count = 0
+primary = {}
+for entry in index['files']:
+    verify(entry, 'snapshot')
+    assert entry['snapshot'] not in primary
+    primary[entry['snapshot']] = entry
+    source = entry.get('source')
+    if source is None:
+        assert all(entry.get(k) == sole_null[k] for k in ['group', 'source', 'snapshot', 'bytes', 'sha256'])
+        null_count += 1
+        check('source_not_applicable_generated_report_snapshot_verified', True, entry)
+    else:
+        assert isinstance(source, str) and source
+        verify(entry, 'source')
+assert null_count == 1
+
+
+def subset(entries, expected_count, group):
+    assert isinstance(entries, list) and len(entries) == expected_count
+    for entry in entries:
+        assert entry['group'] == group and primary.get(entry['snapshot']) == entry
+    check('typed primary subset ' + group, True, expected_count)
+
+
+subset(index['sources'], 6, 'current_source')
+subset(index['raw'], 5, 'actual_command_raw')
+subset(index['fixture'], 1192, 'actual_fixture_regular')
+assert isinstance(index['ledgers'], dict) and len(index['ledgers']) == 4
+subset([x['file'] for x in index['ledgers'].values()], 4, 'actual_ledger_snapshot')
+assert len(index['protected']) == 53 and len(index['references']) == 9
+for entry in index['protected'] + index['references']:

+
+original_plan = load(R147 / 'plan.json')
+command = original_plan['inherited_new_green19']

+assert len(index['runs']) == 4
+mapping = {}

+expected_counts = [(20, 19, 1), (1, 1, 0), (19, 19, 0), (1, 1, 0)]
+for run, counts in zip(index['runs'], expected_counts):

+    suites = list(tree.iter('testsuite'))

+    passed, failed = set(), set()

+    check('actual JUnit recorded exact nodes ' + run['run'], passed == set(run['passed_nodes']) and failed == set(run['failed_or_nonpass_nodes']))

+subset(index['lifecycle_files'], 18, 'actual_fixture_regular')
+lifecycle = []
+special_records = []

+    special = previous['check'] == 'actual lifecycle raw_exit1/shutdown1' and previous['detail'] == '/tmp/bigsmall-p6-r127-new_green/test_private_transaction_helpe2/lifecycle.json'

+    preserved = equal_shape and (previous['match'] == current['match'] if not special else previous['match'] is False and current['match'] is True)

+from pathlib import Path
+from copy import deepcopy
+import hashlib
+import json
+
+ROOT = Path('/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall')
+BASE = ROOT / 'artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds'
+ROUND = BASE / 'round150-p6-metadata-lifecycle-and-review-recovery-20261012'
+OUT = ROUND / 'implementation'
+R147 = BASE / 'round147-p6-foreign-repository-fixture-lock-recovery-20261012'
+
+
+def pin(path, data=None):
+    path = Path(path)
+    data = path.read_bytes() if data is None else data
+    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
+
+
+def encoded(value):
+    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode()
+
+
+def load(path):
+    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())
+
+
+plan = load(ROUND / 'plan.json')
+assert pin(ROUND / 'plan.json')['sha256'] == 'c2cca65a5a83601ef7db1837bddb4ba29bada9f1117edfd8b4521284f817d0da'
+receipt = load(OUT / 'reader.json')
+reader_pin = pin(OUT / 'reader.json')
+assert reader_pin['sha256'] == '4630f9d49ecf1efb71f59f891cb090565d452fdbdd3ea80b2ce93f3a51dd0fed'
+assert receipt['status'] == 'PASS_SCENARIO_AWARE_NEW19_METADATA'
+assert len(receipt['checks']) == 2605 and all(x['match'] for x in receipt['checks'])
+assert load(OUT / 'result.json')['actual_tool_result']['exit_code'] == 0
+assert receipt['unique_terminal_pass_nodes'] == 40 and receipt['single40_run'] is False and receipt['acceptance'] is False
+index = load(R147 / 'implementation/new19-freeze/source-index.json')
+input_pins = {x['path']: x for x in plan['inputs']}
+root_ledger_pins = [index['ledgers'][k]['file'] for k in ['r127_root', 'r147_root']]
+state_path = Path(plan['sync']['state'])
+phase_path = Path(plan['sync']['phase'])
+paths = [Path(x['source']) for x in root_ledger_pins] + [state_path, phase_path]
+expected = [{**x, 'path': x['source']} for x in root_ledger_pins] + [input_pins[str(state_path)], input_pins[str(phase_path)]]
+before = [p.read_bytes() for p in paths]
+assert all(len(b) == x['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() == x['sha256'] for b, x in zip(before, expected))
+original = [json.loads(b) for b in before[:3]]
+new = deepcopy(original)
+actual_result_entry = [x for x in index['raw'] if Path(x['source']).name == 'result.json']
+assert len(actual_result_entry) == 1
+actual_result = load(actual_result_entry[0]['snapshot'])
+assert actual_result['used'] == 1 and actual_result['remaining'] == 0 and actual_result['exit_code'] == 0
+provenance = {'actual_result': actual_result_entry[0], 'complete_root_reader': reader_pin, 'nodes': 19, 'failures': 0, 'errors': 0, 'skipped': 0, 'no_rerun': True, 'review': 'FRESH_FINAL_REVIEW_PENDING'}
+for target in [new[0]['commands']['new_green'], new[1]['inherited_new_green19']]:
+    assert target['authorized'] == 1 and target['used'] == 0 and target['remaining'] == 1
+    assert target['argv'] == actual_result['argv']
+    target.update({'used': 1, 'remaining': 0, 'exit_code': 0, 'status': 'SPENT_ACTUAL19PASS_ROOT_METADATA_VERIFIED', 'provenance': provenance})
+p6 = new[2]['current_P6_stage_A']
+assert p6['P6_complete'] is False and p6['B_C_D'] == 'NOT_ACTIVATED'
+p6['status'] = 'ACTUAL40_UNIQUE_PASS_PENDING_FRESH_FINAL_REVIEW'
+p6['remaining_validation_commands'] = 0
+p6['production_writes'] = 'Final six-source freeze verified; five production files fixed after R145 type-only bridge, test fixed after R147 exact foreign fixture-only repair. Independent final review pending.'
+p6['R127']['final_gates'] = 'ALL_PRODUCT_COMMANDS_SPENT_FRESH_FINAL_REVIEW_PENDING'
+p6['R127']['new_green_actual'] = deepcopy(provenance)
+p6['R147']['original_new19'] = 'ACTUAL19PASS_SPENT1_0_ROOT_VERIFIED_NO_RERUN'
+p6['R147']['new19_index'] = pin(R147 / 'implementation/new19-freeze/source-index.json')
+p6['terminal_pass_evidence'] = {'unique_nodes': 40, 'single40_run': False, 'runs': [{'run': x['run'], 'passed': len(x['passed']), 'failed': len(x['failed'])} for x in receipt['actual_runs']], 'complete_root_reader': reader_pin, 'original19pass1fail_preserved': True, 'source_proof_bridge': 'R145 type-only and R147 exact test-fixture delta', 'controlled_positive': 'CPU_CONTROLLED_OUTCOME_NOT_PHYSICS_EVIDENCE'}
+p6['R148'] = {'status': 'OPTIONAL_AUTHOR_PREFLIGHT_ABANDONED_ZERO_RETRY', 'evidence': [x for x in index['references'] if '/round148-' in x['path']], 'product_commands': 0, 'software_accepted': False}
+p6['R149'] = {'status': 'ACTUAL_METADATA_EXIT1_PRESERVED_NO_SYNC', 'used': 1, 'remaining': 0, 'reader': receipt['prior_actual_exit1_preserved'], 'result': pin(BASE / 'round149-p6-root-new19-index-null-recovery-20261012/implementation/result.json'), 'product_commands': 0, 'software_accepted': False}
+p6['R150'] = {'status': 'SCENARIO_AWARE_METADATA_VERIFIED_FINAL_REVIEW_PENDING', 'plan_sha256': pin(ROUND / 'plan.json')['sha256'], 'reader': reader_pin, 'actual_exit': 0, 'used': 1, 'remaining': 0, 'product_commands': 0, 'original2560_preserved': True, 'checks': 2605, 'lifecycle': '17 single-worker shutdown1; one pinned two-worker shared-log shutdown2; per-worker attribution source-supported inference', 'old_review_protocol': '2 failures and 3 unplanned replacement reads preserved, no retrospective approval', 'software_accepted': False}

+masked = deepcopy(new)
+masked[0]['commands']['new_green'] = original[0]['commands']['new_green']
+masked[1]['inherited_new_green19'] = original[1]['inherited_new_green19']

+assert masked == original
+assert new[2]['full_objective_complete'] is False and new[2]['formal_accepted'] is False

+## 2026-10-12 P6 阶段 A：40 个唯一节点证据齐备，终审待完成
+
+R127 new_green 实际退出0、19 PASS，原一次额度已耗用1/0；ROOT两账本旧待执行值在保存 before 后按事实同步，绝不形成新运行额度。四份实际运行提供40个唯一通过节点：旧20运行19 PASS/1 FAIL保留，R147修正 foreign fixture 单例1 PASS，R127原新增19例19 PASS，R141 CPU受控结果正链1 PASS。不是单次40例通过；原失败保留。
+
+R149实际汇总退出1：共享日志双worker用例被过窄 shutdown1 条件拒绝。R150 genuine Astra 审查后仅该固定原件要求 shutdown2，其余17份仍shutdown1；真实有序调用、两不同job/lease终态及第二worker BLOCKED_BY_ENV/INTERRUPTED ended-at交叉核对。逐worker归因是源代码支持的推断，未捏造逐实例日志。新reader实际0，2605项全部有效，原2560项逐一对应。完整1208快照、1207来源、1192fixture、53保护文件、7symlink与四run映射已核对。
+
+独立终审两次读取失败及随后3次未经新计划的替代读取全部保留；R150只读恢复已激活，终态结论仍待完成。此更新不授予阶段A验收、B/C/D、native、真实物理或正式研究验收；当前可申请的软件上限为 LEASE_FOUNDATION_WITH_LEGACY_UTC_VETO。
+"""
+after = [encoded(x) for x in new] + [before[3] + appendix.encode()]
+names = ['before-r127-root-ledger.json', 'before-r147-root-ledger.json', 'before-state.json', 'before-phase-summary.md']
+for name, data in zip(names, before):
+    with (OUT / name).open('xb') as f:
+        f.write(data)
+for path, data in zip(paths, before):
+    assert path.read_bytes() == data, 'Concurrent metadata change; stop before all writes'
+for path, data in zip(paths, after):
+    path.write_bytes(data)
+assert all(path.read_bytes() == data for path, data in zip(paths, after))
+report = {'status': 'CONTROLLED_FACT_SYNC_COMPLETE_NO_ACCEPTANCE', 'authorized': 1, 'used': 1, 'remaining': 0, 'reader': reader_pin, 'before': [pin(p, b) for p, b in zip(paths, before)], 'after': [pin(p, b) for p, b in zip(paths, after)], 'unrelated_json_fields_preserved': masked == original, 'phase_append_only': after[3].startswith(before[3]), 'product_execution': 0, 'budget_reset': False, 'software_acceptance': False}
+with (OUT / 'sync-report.json').open('xb') as f:
+    f.write(encoded(report))
+print(json.dumps({'status': report['status'], 'sync_report': pin(OUT / 'sync-report.json'), 'writes': len(paths)}, ensure_ascii=False))

+# R150：生命周期汇总条件与终审读取协议恢复
+
+实际规划者：gpt-6-astra，2026-10-12。冻结待 ROOT 激活。完整输入 pins、两条独立轨道、精确命令和有限额度见 plan.json。
+
+## M1：汇总条件过度概括
+
+R149 单次实际 exit1，spent1/0，2560 checks 中2559通过、1项失败。失败不能改称通过。原计划本身要求每份 lifecycle 恰好一次 shutdown；实施者遵循了这个过窄条件，本轮明确记录 Astra 原计划的条件错误。
+
+独立核对18份原记录：17份 raw_enter1/raw_exit1/shutdown1；唯一 test_private_transaction_helpe2 为 raw_enter1/raw_exit1/shutdown2。全部 session_closed=true，SHA匹配。其冻结测试实际启动第二个 worker，物理 initialize 被明确阻断；软件 factory 的构造器始终返回同一 backend，共享 calls。worker 的 finally 在 initialize 失败时也 shutdown，尚未进入 raw context。因此顺序为第二worker shutdown、外层 raw_exit、外层 shutdown，且两个不同job/lease均终止。这支持“汇总器条件错误”，不支持把当前证据称产品重复清理故障；完整产品正确性仍待终审。
+
+ROOT 新建 /home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round150-p6-metadata-lifecycle-and-review-recovery-20261012/implementation/read-new19-lifecycle.py，全文及SHA复核后仅一次执行。必须保留原2560项检查及对应关系，只为精确固定的特殊记录规定 shutdown2，其他17仍shutdown1；增加逐场景解释与原调用顺序、两job终态交叉核对。不得 >=1、跳过、去重或改raw。共享日志没有逐实例标签，逐worker归因须标为源代码支持的推断。
+
+新输出 exclusive-create reader/invocation/result/stdout/stderr，真实分离捕获和工具返回；stdout只路径/hash/counts，少于1500字符。原R149 reader不重跑，旧exit1和预算不改。新读取器有1次纯metadata额度，任何不匹配停止，不能同步。
+
+## M2：独立终审读取协议偏离
+
+原001猜测 sources/tests 路径实际exit2；002 bare python实际exit127。此后003 python3与004/005 nl/sed实际执行成功，共3次未经计划的替代读取。19份manifest原件核对一致，完整可得combined保留；没有独立streams，不补造。旧draft是STOPPED preliminary，绝非最终验收，不能追溯抹掉偏离。
+
+激活后原独立 reviewer 可继续，不必等待主汇总完成。只使用 index.sources 的真实flat snapshot绝对路径和 .venv/bin/python stdlib文本/JSON/XML/hash，最多24个有界读取batch，每次源文chunk至多600行。已有阅读可带provenance复用，不为凑数重读。新失败立即停，不再自行替代。最终报告写入本轮review目录，明确完整冻结六源/实际raw、fixture、JUnit、proof桥核查和未决事项，保留两失败三替代读记录。
+
+## 范围、同步与验收
+
+本轮零产品/测试编辑、零pytest/static/AST/import/compile/collect/SQL/probe/Git额度；所有原产品命令已耗用，不重置。独立审查若发现真实产品根因，另列严格新计划，不在本轮试跑或修复。
+
+仅新汇总器所有检查有效且ROOT审阅后，允许一次受控元数据同步：两ROOT账本new_green派生spent1/0/actual0，STATE事实40unique四run/remaining0/终审待完成，PHASE追加。先exclusive保存before件并立即比较字节防并发；不改其他预算、Git、原冻结字节或P6验收值。STATE/PHASE本轮已读取并pin；具体字段边界见JSON。原R149停止时未做同步的事实永久保留。

+完成元数据恢复不表示A验收。原40unique是旧19 retained＋修正foreign1＋new19＋CPUpositive1，绝非单次40run。独立终审仍必须完成；StageA上限 LEASE_FOUNDATION_WITH_LEGACY_UTC_VETO，B/C/D/native/actual/formal仍不获验收。

+# STOP finding contract addendum
+
+This addendum preserves the original final-review.md/json and R150-B1 report unchanged. It narrows their interpretation; it is not a new source review or reproduction.

+# R151：终态提交后失确认的合同裁决与独审恢复
+
+实际规划者：gpt-6-astra，2026-10-12。冻结待 ROOT 激活。完整路径、输入 SHA256、剩余读取和原同步额度见 plan.json。
+
+## 原始发现与裁决
+
+R150-B1 原 STOP Important 候选报告及补充说明全部保留。独立核对 stop-authority-index 的12份原件均匹配。终态COMMIT后同连接关闭或confirm/consume失效的精确触发尚未实际复现，无新fault raw、pytest或运行traceback；不得把源码推演写成已观察反例。
+
+源码事实成立：SQL实际COMMIT在reread/private ack与broker确认之前；后续异常会撤回本次promoted公开文件，保留unconfirmed诊断并写accepted=false。已落地的SUCCEEDED job、ended attempt和released lease不会被负向cleanup覆盖。
+
+这些事实不支持“未转REVOKED所以仍有权限”的结论：
+- R113 design75–82明确区分SQL COMMITTED与broker ACTIVE；失ack保留committed行作为不授权的证据，safe cleanup为may。COMMIT是持久化变更的线性化点，不是单独的live execution authority。
+- final confirm/consume并非纯transport ACK，它确实fresh-read原hard-open bound并影响私有ACTIVE；当前broker747–754同时要求精确generation/digest且拒绝TERMINAL。
+- R127 Task3禁止无权覆盖已经terminal success；当前终态历史保留符合该边界，不得为了消除表面矛盾把SUCCEEDED改失败、重开attempt/lease或增设第二activation。
+
+公开消费事实另行保留：protected service.py的run/attempt/artifact/batch路径直接呈现SQL状态与artifact_paths，没有读取rejection.json或明确“出版已确认”标识。因此不能声称公开reader已有unconfirmed veto。本次没有发现把这些字段单独当broker权限或已验收物理/正式证据的消费者。该公开呈现缺少区分是明确的B9规划输入，限制所有“完整出版/消费者闭合”主张，不静默略去。
+
+裁决为：**本候选不足以证明受限StageA租约权威的新产品缺陷；不授权产品修复或新测试，恢复独立终审。** 这不是总体软件通过结论。已有40unique四次实际运行也未覆盖精确final-COMMIT故障，保留该覆盖边界，不据此伪造RED或追加无关全套回归。
+
+报告分类也需在新说明中纠正：R134 S是dataclass证据序列化，C是异常安全清理，F是真实commit-close fixture；R147才是foreign fixture修正。旧报告不改写。
+
+## 独立终审恢复
+
+原 R150 TrackB 共24批，实际已用7，继承剩余17；不重置、不新加读取额度。ROOT激活后原独立reviewer /root/p6_a_review 从第8批继续，沿原 .venv stdlib/text、flat index.sources、每chunk≤600行规则。前两失败与三次未经计划替代读取永久保留。
+
+新终审报告输出 /home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round151-p6-terminal-ackloss-contract-disposition-20261012/review/final-review.md 与 final-review.json，不能覆盖原R150 STOP报告。完成尚未完成的raw/fixture/type-proof/foreign-delta和E1–E7/G1–G4/R134S-C-F审查，纳入本裁决和公开消费者限制。Reviewer可以提出不同、具体的新缺陷；本计划不要求其给出PASS。任何新故障先停，不在此轮修复或试跑。
+

+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib
+import json
+
+INDEX = Path("/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round134-p6-red-interface-connection-recovery-20261011/implementation/recovery3-freeze/source-index.json")

+data = INDEX.read_bytes()
+assert len(data) == 111415
+assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == "f74193993185e323d2b688638517f599d7871352093e90f8c69bbf07d61edc36"
+index = json.loads(data)
+assert type(index) is dict
+assert set(index) == {"status", "files", "sources", "actual_case_regular_files", "actual_symlinks", "root_ledger_note"}
+assert type(index["actual_case_regular_files"]) is int
+assert index["actual_case_regular_files"] == 181
+assert type(index["files"]) is list and len(index["files"]) == 197
+assert type(index["sources"]) is list and len(index["sources"]) == 6
+assert type(index["actual_symlinks"]) is list and len(index["actual_symlinks"]) == 2
+files = index["files"]
+snapshot_only = []
+seen = set()
+for record in files:
+    assert type(record) is dict
+    assert set(record) in ({"source", "snapshot", "bytes", "sha256"}, {"snapshot", "bytes", "sha256"})
+    assert type(record["snapshot"]) is str and Path(record["snapshot"]).is_absolute()
+    assert record["snapshot"] not in seen
+    seen.add(record["snapshot"])
+    assert type(record["bytes"]) is int and record["bytes"] >= 0
+    assert type(record["sha256"]) is str and len(record["sha256"]) == 64
+    assert all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in record["sha256"])
+    if "source" in record:
+        assert type(record["source"]) is str and Path(record["source"]).is_absolute()
+    else:
+        snapshot_only.append(record)
+assert snapshot_only == [{"snapshot": "/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round134-p6-red-interface-connection-recovery-20261011/implementation/recovery3-freeze/step-report.json", "bytes": 21247, "sha256": "e1d99926ef9b4b217b04c6c84d2d5d10f6d85aeb8dfc4659b862f5a9b0cb7380"}]
+assert all(record in files and "source" in record for record in index["sources"])
+case_records = [record for record in files if record.get("source", "").startswith("/tmp/bigsmall-p6-r134-recovery3/")]
+assert len(case_records) == index["actual_case_regular_files"]
+for record in index["actual_symlinks"]:
+    assert type(record) is dict and set(record) == {"source", "relative_path", "target", "kind"}
+    assert all(type(record[k]) is str and record[k] for k in record)
+    assert Path(record["source"]).is_absolute() and Path(record["target"]).is_absolute()
+    assert not Path(record["relative_path"]).is_absolute()
+    assert record["kind"] == "actual symlink metadata; regular target bytes preserved by complete case-tree"
+result = {

+## Strengths
+
+Private authority is tied to concrete writer/function/frame ownership and the actual guarded transaction. Holding a publication lock or a TLS connection cannot issue a lease capability. Same-job subordinate writers remain possible under the registered owner's connection; foreign-job nesting and positive status CAS with mismatched ownership reject. The issued view has independently sealed bindings for repository/database/connection/nonce/process/thread/session/job/lease/attempt/generation/revision/purpose/operation/full row and an issuer-controlled lifecycle.
+
+The source separates SQL durability from broker authority. A proposal is PENDING, real INSERT/CAS must affect exactly one row and commit once, the concrete transaction owner rereads using the same connection to issue a private ack, and the broker freshly checks its original domain before activating the exact generation. SQL COMMITTED alone is nonauthorizing. Acquisition starts after guard+BEGIN; early heartbeat preserves ACQUIRED/attempt-null until real start_attempt binds the unique open attempt. Renewal preserves original acquisition/task budgets and original domains. Response confirmation/consumption retains the original prior hard-open bound and rejects equality as expiry; timeout/cancel/reassignment/rollback/late reply cannot renew authority retroactively.
+
+Worker poll-wide finally covers acquire/initial heartbeat/bind failures, invalidates authority before stopping the heartbeat and closing the broker in its owning thread, and closes residual current job/attempt/lease through restricted negative cleanup. Historical terminal truth is preserved. Recovery terminates genuine unfinished old epochs before legacy expiry/requeue; operational same-job retry and raw QUEUED CAS do not create a new origin.
+
+The actual positive control reaches the normal terminal publication path with genuine CAS/COMMIT/readback/private ack/fresh broker confirmation. It calls the original software episode once, then changes only six outcome flags. It retains zero measured quantities, actions, model calls and verification evidence. The same job/attempt/lease ends SUCCEEDED/ended/released, natural job/result/attempt/lease/transition/events files agree, and all22 declared generated hashes match independent frozen byte recomputation and the natural consistency file. This supports a software publication path only.

Broker fresh-read/proposal enters PENDING, binding the exact proposed generation and canonical target row whose durable_phase will be COMMITTED. Suspend positive use of the replaced generation while this proposal is unresolved.\n78: 2. Execute the real INSERT/CAS (rowcount1) writing the target receipt, generation, proposal_id, operation hash, row revision and `durable_phase=COMMITTED`; commit once. These bytes remain uncommitted until that actual commit returns successfully. On rollback/CAS0/commit ambiguity invalidate the view/proposal and fail closed.\n79: 3. Still holding publication guard, the concrete transaction owner records the successful commit and re-reads the committed row using that connection. It creates one private CommitAck bound to this real commit identity, proposal and canonical target-row digest. Read-only evidence/JSON or caller-supplied digest cannot mint an ack. Pass the exact registered ack to broker; broker performs its own fresh original-domain read and activates that exact generation only if the request/session remains live. For heartbeat/bind it rechecks the prior segment's original hard-open bound as well as the proposed segment; a commit that crossed the old expiry cannot renew retroactively. It does not acquire a database lock or query SQL itself.\n80: 4. Broker ACTIVE plus the exact SQL COMMITTED generation/digest/lifecycle is required for a positive evaluation. An SQL COMMITTED row with broker PENDING, absent, revoked or mismatched is unusable. Ack success changes only broker state, **not SQL**, and produces a detached audit receipt. Close the view/transaction handles after acknowledgement; their replay cannot authorize another operation.\n81: \n82: Lost acknowledgement or late response leaves the committed row as nonauthorizing evidence and revokes/blocks that session. Subsequent safe release/orphan termination may write REVOKED/TERMINATED in its own cleanup transaction; this is not a second activation phase. A late reply never activates the blocked epoch. An old ACTIVE segment cannot authorize the new generation. Do not serialize broker ACTIVE as a durable live permission or infer it on restart.\n83: \n84: Use an additive table owned by sqlite_repository (no new model/schema file): `simulation_operational_leases_v1`, keyed by lease_id, storing schema, job/run/worker/attempt, process/boot/start identity, epoch, generation, row revision, original job/policy digest, original acquisition receipt JSON, current segment receipt JSON, proposal_id, proposed row digest, durable_phase, terminal reason. The canonical target-row digest excludes only its own digest column; it includes the exact durable_phase/lifecycle and all original/segment/source/CAS fields. Broker state is not a durable authority column. Detached receipt fields contain both domain identity and integer-ns event bounds; bool/nonfinite/mixed-domain inputs reject. UTC columns remain legacy/diagnostic and continue the explicit stage-A extra veto; new D lease decisions never use them to create, renew or expire authority.\n85: \n86: The table also stores lifecycle `ACQUIRED|ATTEMPT_BOUND|TERMINAL`; attempt is null only in ACQUIRED and must equal the actual unique open attempt in ATTEMPT_BOUND. This is not a budget-reset state machine.\n87: \n88: All actual job writers participate in the same publication guard. Do not globally pretend the current `_connect` commits: it uses isolation_level=None and only rolls back on exception/closes. New transactions explicitly BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK. +from pathlib import Path
+import base64
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import stat
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path('/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall')
+D = ROOT / 'artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round153-p6-stage-a-finite-git-delivery-20261012'
+I = D / 'implementation'
+DELIVERY = Path('/home/ningyd/.codex/worktrees/t12-p1-delivery/BIGsmall')
+BASE = 'cb59be66fe281d7ee2c1ca90bc803c3b80f37c76'
+PLAN = json.loads((D / 'plan.json').read_text())
+SPECS = {x['id']: x for x in PLAN['git_budget']['commands']}
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+def pin(p):
+    p = Path(p)
+    assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(), str(p)
+    b = p.read_bytes()
+    return {'path': str(p), 'bytes': len(b), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)}
+
+def expected(p, record):
+    a = pin(p)
+    assert all(a[k] == record[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')), (str(p), a, record)
+    if 'mode' in record:
+        assert a['mode'] == record['mode'], (str(p), 'mode')
+    return a
+
+def save(p, obj):
+    p = Path(p)
+    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with p.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+def write_bytes(p, b):
+    p = Path(p)
+    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with p.open('xb') as f:
+        f.write(b)
+
+def relative(p):
+    p = Path(p)
+    r = p.relative_to(ROOT)
+    assert str(r) and not any(x in ('.', '..') for x in r.parts)
+    assert '\x00' not in str(r) and '\n' not in str(r)
+    return str(r)
+
+def safe_parent(p, root):
+    p = Path(p)
+    p.relative_to(root)
+    assert not root.is_symlink()
+    for q in (p, *p.parents):
+        if q == root:
+            break
+        assert not q.is_symlink(), str(q)
+        if q != p and q.exists():
+            assert q.is_dir(), str(q)
+
+def git(command_id, argv=None, stdin=None, allowed=(0,)):
+    spec = SPECS[command_id]
+    gd = I / 'git'
+    gd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    ordinal = next((n for n in range(1, spec['max_runs'] + 1)
+                    if not (gd / f'{command_id}-{n}.invocation.json').exists()), None)
+    assert ordinal is not None, ('budget exhausted', command_id)
+    args = list(argv or spec['argv'])
+    prefix = gd / f'{command_id}-{ordinal}'
+    invocation = {'id': command_id, 'ordinal': ordinal, 'argv': args,
+                  'cwd': spec['cwd'], 'start_utc': now(), 'stdin_bytes': len(stdin or b'')}
+    if stdin is not None:
+        write_bytes(str(prefix) + '.stdin.bin', stdin)
+        invocation['stdin_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(stdin).hexdigest()
+    save(str(prefix) + '.invocation.json', invocation)
+    result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=spec['cwd'], input=stdin, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+    write_bytes(str(prefix) + '.stdout.txt', result.stdout)
+    write_bytes(str(prefix) + '.stderr.txt', result.stderr)
+    record = {**invocation, 'end_utc': now(), 'exit_code': result.returncode,
+              'stdout': pin(str(prefix) + '.stdout.txt'), 'stderr': pin(str(prefix) + '.stderr.txt')}
+    save(str(prefix) + '.result.json', record)
+    assert result.returncode in allowed, ('actual Git failure preserved', command_id, ordinal, result.returncode)
+    return result.stdout, result.stderr, record
+
+def entries(b):
+    parts = b.split(b'\0')
+    result = []
+    n = 0
+    while n < len(parts) and parts[n]:
+        item = parts[n].decode('utf-8')
+        xy, path = item[:2], item[3:]
+        other = None
+        if 'R' in xy or 'C' in xy:
+            n += 1
+            other = parts[n].decode('utf-8')
+        result.append({'status': xy, 'path': path, 'other': other})
+        n += 1
+    return result
+
+def payload_records():
+    index = json.loads((D / 'payload-index.json').read_text())
+    rows = index['files'] + [dict(pin(D / n), relative_path=relative(D / n), role='nonselfreferential-index') for n in ('payload-index.json', 'delivery-paths.txt')]
+    assert len(rows) == 759
+    return sorted(rows, key=lambda x: x['relative_path'])
+
+
+import re
+import shlex
+
+def stage():
+    rows = payload_records()
+    byrel = {x['relative_path']: x for x in rows}
+    copied = json.loads((I / 'copy-receipt.json').read_text())
+    expected_changed = set(copied['expected_changed_paths'])
+    for x in rows:
+        expected(x['path'], x)
+        expected(DELIVERY / x['relative_path'], x)
+    git('G9')
+    out, _, name_record = git('G10')
+    parts = out.split(b'\0')
+    changed = {}
+    n = 0
+    while n < len(parts) and parts[n]:
+        change = parts[n].decode()
+        name = parts[n + 1].decode()
+        assert change in ('A', 'M'), (change, name)
+        assert name not in changed
+        changed[name] = change
+        n += 2
+    assert set(changed) == expected_changed, ('staged path mismatch', sorted(set(changed) ^ expected_changed))
+    out, _, mode_record = git('G11', ['git', 'ls-files', '--stage', '-z', '--', *sorted(byrel)])
+    staged = []
+    for item in out.split(b'\0'):
+        if item:
+            left, name = item.decode().split('\t', 1)
+            mode, oid, stage_number = left.split()
+            assert stage_number == '0' and mode in ('100644', '100755')
+            assert name in byrel
+            assert mode == ('100755' if byrel[name]['mode'] & 0o111 else '100644')
+            staged.append({'path': name, 'mode': mode, 'oid': oid})
+    assert len(staged) == 759 and {x['path'] for x in staged} == set(byrel)
+    out, _, blob_record = git('G12', stdin=b''.join((x['oid'] + '\n').encode() for x in staged))
+    pos = 0
+    for x in staged:
+        end = out.index(b'\n', pos)
+        oid, kind, size = out[pos:end].decode().split()
+        assert oid == x['oid'] and kind == 'blob'
+        start = end + 1
+        b = out[start:start + int(size)]
+        pos = start + int(size)
+        assert out[pos:pos + 1] == b'\n'
+        pos += 1
+        p = byrel[x['path']]
+        assert len(b) == p['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() == p['sha256']
+    assert pos == len(out)
+    diff, _, diff_record = git('G13')
+    headers = []
+    hunk_counts = {}
+    current = None
+    for line in diff.splitlines():
+        if line.startswith(b'diff --git '):
+            a, b = shlex.split(line.decode())[2:]
+            assert a.startswith('a/') and b.startswith('b/') and a[2:] == b[2:]
+            current = a[2:]
+            headers.append(current)
+            hunk_counts[current] = 0
+        elif line.startswith(b'@@ '):
+            hunk_counts[current] += 1
+    assert set(headers) == expected_changed and len(headers) == len(expected_changed)
+    strict = {x['relative_path'] for x in rows if x['role'] == 'current-owned-source'}
+    owned = json.loads((I / 'preflight.json').read_text())['current_owned']
+    strict.update(relative(x['source']) for x in owned)
+    strict.update(relative(p) for p in PLAN['payload']['exact_additional_paths'])
+    out, err, ws_record = git('G14', allowed=(0, 1, 2))
+    exceptions = []
+    diagnostics = out.decode().splitlines()
+    for line in diagnostics:
+        m = re.fullmatch(r'(.+):(\d+): (.+)', line)
+        if m:
+            path, number, diagnosis = m.groups()
+            assert path in byrel and path not in strict, ('unexpected whitespace', path, line)
+            p = byrel[path]
+            assert p['role'] != 'R153-derived-or-updated-status'
+            original_lines = Path(p['path']).read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
+            number = int(number)
+            assert 1 <= number <= len(original_lines)
+            exceptions.append({'path': path, 'role': p['role'], 'file_sha256': p['sha256'],
+                               'line': number, 'line_bytes_sha256': hashlib.sha256(original_lines[number - 1]).hexdigest(),
+                               'actual_diagnostic': line, 'reason': 'Frozen historical evidence, exact bytes preserved.'})
+        else:
+            assert line.startswith('+') or not line.strip(), ('unrecognized diff-check output', line)
+    assert not err
+    assert ws_record['exit_code'] == 0 or exceptions
+    save(I / 'whitespace-exceptions.json', {'actual_exit_code': ws_record['exit_code'], 'exceptions': exceptions,
+                                           'original_artifact_bytes_unchanged': True})
+    out, err, strict_record = git('G15', ['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check', '--', *sorted(strict)])
+    assert not out and not err
+    receipt = {'status': 'STAGED_ALL_759_BLOBS_BYTE_MODE_AND_PATHS_MATCH',
+               'payload_count': 759, 'changed_count': len(changed), 'changed': changed,
+               'unchanged_selected_paths': sorted(set(byrel) - expected_changed),
+               'bytes': sum(x['bytes'] for x in rows), 'staged': staged,
+               'full_diff': diff_record['stdout'], 'diff_headers': headers, 'hunk_counts': hunk_counts,
+               'blob_capture': blob_record['stdout'], 'whitespace_exceptions': pin(I / 'whitespace-exceptions.json'),
+               'strict_diff_check': strict_record, 'pending_ROOT_finite_diff_gate': True}
+    save(I / 'staged-receipt.json', receipt)
+    save(I / 'precommit-receipt.json', {'status': 'ALL_PAYLOAD_BYTES_VERIFIED_PENDING_ROOT_COMMIT_GATE',
+                                       'files': rows, 'payload_index': pin(D / 'payload-index.json'),
+                                       'delivery_paths': pin(D / 'delivery-paths.txt'),
+                                       'staged_receipt': pin(I / 'staged-receipt.json')})
+    print(json.dumps({'phase': 'staged_audit', 'payload_files': 759, 'changed_files': len(changed),
+                      'bytes': receipt['bytes'], 'all_blobs_match': True, 'strict_check_exit': 0,
+                      'historical_whitespace_exit': ws_record['exit_code'], 'historical_exceptions': len(exceptions),
+                      'code_hunks': {relative(x['source']): hunk_counts.get(relative(x['source']), 0) for x in owned},
+                      'full_diff': receipt['full_diff'], 'receipt': pin(I / 'staged-receipt.json')}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+def deliver():
+    receipt = json.loads((I / 'staged-receipt.json').read_text())
+    assert receipt['status'] == 'STAGED_ALL_759_BLOBS_BYTE_MODE_AND_PATHS_MATCH'
+    for x in payload_records():
+        expected(x['path'], x)
+        expected(DELIVERY / x['relative_path'], x)
+    out, _, _ = git('G1')
+    assert out.strip().decode() == BASE
+    commit_out, _, commit_result = git('G16')
+    gd_text = (DELIVERY / '.git').read_text().strip()
+    assert gd_text.startswith('gitdir: ')
+    gd = Path(gd_text[8:])
+    if not gd.is_absolute():
+        gd = DELIVERY / gd
+    common_dir = gd
+    if (gd / 'commondir').exists():
+        c = Path((gd / 'commondir').read_text().strip())
+        common_dir = c if c.is_absolute() else gd / c
+    ref = common_dir / 'refs/heads/codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery'
+    created = ref.read_text().strip()
+    assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', created) and created != BASE
+    assert created[:7].encode() in commit_out
+    out, _, _ = git('G6')
+    assert out.decode().strip().split('\t') == [BASE, 'refs/heads/codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery']
+    git('G17')
+    identity = {}
+    for command_id in ('G1', 'G4', 'G6', 'G5'):
+        out, _, result = git(command_id)
+        if command_id == 'G6':
+            value, remote_ref = out.decode().strip().split('\t')
+            assert remote_ref == 'refs/heads/codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery'
+            identity['live_remote'] = value
+        elif command_id == 'G5':
+            assert not out
+            identity['delivery_clean'] = True
+        else:
+            identity['local_HEAD' if command_id == 'G1' else 'upstream_HEAD'] = out.strip().decode()
+    assert identity['local_HEAD'] == identity['upstream_HEAD'] == identity['live_remote'] == created
+    pf = json.loads((I / 'preflight.json').read_text())
+    expected(pf['main_index']['path'], pf['main_index'])
+    out, _, _ = git('M3')
+    after = entries(out)
+    allowed_files = {relative(x['path']) for x in PLAN['metadata_update']['before']}
+    prefix = relative(D) + '/'
+    def preserved(es):
+        return sorted((x['status'], x['path'], x['other'] or '') for x in es
+                      if x['path'] not in allowed_files and not x['path'].startswith(prefix))
+    assert preserved(pf['main_status_before']) == preserved(after)
+    rows = payload_records()
+    for x in rows:
+        expected(x['path'], x)
+        expected(DELIVERY / x['relative_path'], x)
+    specs = []
+    used = 0
+    for command_id, spec in SPECS.items():
+        for n in range(1, spec['max_runs'] + 1):
+            p = I / 'git' / f'{command_id}-{n}.result.json'
+            if p.exists():
+                specs.append(pin(p))
+                used += 1
+    assert used <= 28
+    final = {'status': 'BOUNDED_STAGE_A_SELECTED_DELIVERY_COMMITTED_PUSHED_VERIFIED',
+             'time_utc': now(), 'branch': 'codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery',
+             'base': BASE, 'commit': created, 'identity': identity, 'git_commands_used': used,
+             'git_commands_remaining': 28 - used, 'retry_budget': 0,
+             'files': 759, 'changed_files': receipt['changed_count'], 'bytes': sum(x['bytes'] for x in rows),
+             'payload_index': pin(D / 'payload-index.json'), 'delivery_paths': pin(D / 'delivery-paths.txt'),
+             'plan': pin(D / 'plan.json'), 'acceptance': pin(D / 'acceptance.json'),
+             'staged_receipt': pin(I / 'staged-receipt.json'), 'precommit_receipt': pin(I / 'precommit-receipt.json'),
+             'actual_git_results': specs, 'main_index_unchanged': True, 'main_unrelated_dirty_entries_retained': True,
+             'B9_open': True, 'whole_P6_complete': False, 'native_physics_actual_formal_accepted': False,
+             'remote_reproduction': 'SELECTED_PACKAGE_ONLY_NOT_FULL_FIXTURE_RAW_DATABASE_PACKAGE',
+             'receipt_location': 'LOCAL_OUTSIDE_COMMIT_NO_SELF_REFERENCE'}
+    save(D / 'postpush-receipt.json', final)
+    print(json.dumps({k: final[k] for k in ('status', 'commit', 'identity', 'git_commands_used', 'files', 'changed_files', 'bytes', 'B9_open', 'whole_P6_complete')}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    {'stage': stage, 'deliver': deliver}[sys.argv[1]]()

+from pathlib import Path
+import base64
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import stat
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path('/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall')
+D = ROOT / 'artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round153-p6-stage-a-finite-git-delivery-20261012'
+I = D / 'implementation'
+DELIVERY = Path('/home/ningyd/.codex/worktrees/t12-p1-delivery/BIGsmall')
+BASE = 'cb59be66fe281d7ee2c1ca90bc803c3b80f37c76'
+PLAN = json.loads((D / 'plan.json').read_text())
+SPECS = {x['id']: x for x in PLAN['git_budget']['commands']}
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+def pin(p):
+    p = Path(p)
+    assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(), str(p)
+    b = p.read_bytes()
+    return {'path': str(p), 'bytes': len(b), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)}
+
+def expected(p, record):
+    a = pin(p)
+    assert all(a[k] == record[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')), (str(p), a, record)
+    if 'mode' in record:
+        assert a['mode'] == record['mode'], (str(p), 'mode')
+    return a
+
+def save(p, obj):
+    p = Path(p)
+    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with p.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+def write_bytes(p, b):
+    p = Path(p)
+    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with p.open('xb') as f:
+        f.write(b)
+
+def relative(p):
+    p = Path(p)
+    r = p.relative_to(ROOT)
+    assert str(r) and not any(x in ('.', '..') for x in r.parts)
+    assert '\x00' not in str(r) and '\n' not in str(r)
+    return str(r)
+
+def safe_parent(p, root):
+    p = Path(p)
+    p.relative_to(root)
+    assert not root.is_symlink()
+    for q in (p, *p.parents):
+        if q == root:
+            break
+        assert not q.is_symlink(), str(q)
+        if q != p and q.exists():
+            assert q.is_dir(), str(q)
+
+def git(command_id, argv=None, stdin=None, allowed=(0,)):
+    spec = SPECS[command_id]
+    gd = I / 'git'
+    gd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    ordinal = next((n for n in range(1, spec['max_runs'] + 1)
+                    if not (gd / f'{command_id}-{n}.invocation.json').exists()), None)
+    assert ordinal is not None, ('budget exhausted', command_id)
+    args = list(argv or spec['argv'])
+    prefix = gd / f'{command_id}-{ordinal}'
+    invocation = {'id': command_id, 'ordinal': ordinal, 'argv': args,
+                  'cwd': spec['cwd'], 'start_utc': now(), 'stdin_bytes': len(stdin or b'')}
+    if stdin is not None:
+        write_bytes(str(prefix) + '.stdin.bin', stdin)
+        invocation['stdin_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(stdin).hexdigest()
+    save(str(prefix) + '.invocation.json', invocation)
+    result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=spec['cwd'], input=stdin, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+    write_bytes(str(prefix) + '.stdout.txt', result.stdout)
+    write_bytes(str(prefix) + '.stderr.txt', result.stderr)
+    record = {**invocation, 'end_utc': now(), 'exit_code': result.returncode,
+              'stdout': pin(str(prefix) + '.stdout.txt'), 'stderr': pin(str(prefix) + '.stderr.txt')}
+    save(str(prefix) + '.result.json', record)
+    assert result.returncode in allowed, ('actual Git failure preserved', command_id, ordinal, result.returncode)
+    return result.stdout, result.stderr, record
+
+def entries(b):
+    parts = b.split(b'\0')
+    result = []
+    n = 0
+    while n < len(parts) and parts[n]:
+        item = parts[n].decode('utf-8')
+        xy, path = item[:2], item[3:]
+        other = None
+        if 'R' in xy or 'C' in xy:
+            n += 1
+            other = parts[n].decode('utf-8')
+        result.append({'status': xy, 'path': path, 'other': other})
+        n += 1
+    return result
+
+def payload_records():
+    index = json.loads((D / 'payload-index.json').read_text())
+    rows = index['files'] + [dict(pin(D / n), relative_path=relative(D / n), role='nonselfreferential-index') for n in ('payload-index.json', 'delivery-paths.txt')]
+    assert len(rows) == 759
+    return sorted(rows, key=lambda x: x['relative_path'])
+
+
+def inputs():
+    checks = []
+    for name, size, digest in (
+        ('plan.md', 7415, '603d5f8d0847d609f5bd96d8fd866c11b3c1a4bd6c155168d522851009be4061'),
+        ('plan.json', 30433, 'c79ed902b732f4f447c9b86824937b4f88d68a5d8854dea2ab1fb60e51caeddf')):
+        checks.append(expected(D / name, {'bytes': size, 'sha256': digest}))
+    for x in PLAN['inputs']:
+        checks.append(expected(x['path'], x))
+    manifest = json.loads((D / 'selected-manifest.json').read_text())
+    deps = json.loads((D / 'dependency-preparation.json').read_text())
+    assert len(manifest['files']) == 740
+    selected = {x['path']: x for x in manifest['files']}
+    assert len(selected) == 740
+    for x in selected.values():
+        assert relative(x['path']) == x['relative_path']
+        safe_parent(Path(x['path']), ROOT)
+        checks.append(expected(x['path'], x))
+    for x in manifest['omitted_same_bytes']:
+        c = selected[x['canonical_selected_path']]
+        assert all(c[k] == x[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256'))
+    state = json.loads(Path(PLAN['metadata_update']['before'][0]['path']).read_text())
+    ix = state['current_P6_stage_A']['R147']['new19_index']
+    checks.append(expected(ix['path'], ix))
+    frozen = json.loads(Path(ix['path']).read_text())
+    assert len(frozen['sources']) == 6 and len(frozen['protected']) == 53
+    for x in frozen['sources']:
+        checks.extend([expected(x['source'], x), expected(x['snapshot'], x)])
+    for x in frozen['protected']:
+        checks.append(expected(x['path'], x))
+    for x in deps['dependencies']:
+        checks.extend([expected(ROOT / x['path'], x['primary']), expected(DELIVERY / x['path'], x['delivery'])])
+    owned_before = {x['path']: x for x in deps['owned_delivery_baseline']}
+    for x in owned_before.values():
+        p = DELIVERY / x['path']
+        safe_parent(p, DELIVERY)
+        if x['expected_new']:
+            assert not p.exists()
+        else:
+            checks.append(expected(p, x['delivery']))
+    paths = sorted(set(selected) | set(PLAN['payload']['exact_additional_paths']))
+    assert len(paths) == 759
+    target_before = {}
+    mutable = {x['path'] for x in PLAN['metadata_update']['before']}
+    for source in paths:
+        rel = relative(source)
+        target = DELIVERY / rel
+        safe_parent(target, DELIVERY)
+        if target.exists():
+            old = pin(target)
+            if rel in owned_before:
+                assert not owned_before[rel]['expected_new']
+                expected(target, owned_before[rel]['delivery'])
+            elif source in selected:
+                expected(target, {k: selected[source][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')})
+                assert bool(old['mode'] & 0o111) == bool(selected[source]['mode'] & 0o111)
+            else:
+                assert source in mutable, ('unexpected existing target', source)
+            target_before[rel] = old
+        else:
+            target_before[rel] = None
+    for command_id in ('M1', 'M2', 'M3', 'G1', 'G2', 'G3', 'G4', 'G5', 'G6', 'G7', 'G8'):
+        out, err, record = git(command_id, allowed=(0, 1) if command_id == 'G7' else (0,))
+        checks.append({'git': command_id, 'result': record})
+        if command_id == 'M1':
+            assert out.strip().decode() == '34c7a5595b72a3b23f4d0ca4d31aa4154cd6f24e'
+        elif command_id == 'M2':
+            index_path = Path(out.strip().decode())
+            if not index_path.is_absolute():
+                index_path = ROOT / index_path
+            main_index = pin(index_path)
+        elif command_id == 'M3':
+            main_before = entries(out)
+        elif command_id in ('G1', 'G4'):
+            assert out.strip().decode() == BASE
+        elif command_id == 'G2':
+            assert out.strip().decode() == 'codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery'
+        elif command_id == 'G3':
+            assert out.strip().decode() == 'refs/remotes/origin/codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery'
+        elif command_id == 'G5':
+            assert out == b''
+        elif command_id == 'G6':
+            assert out.decode().strip().split('\t') == [BASE, 'refs/heads/codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery']
+        elif command_id == 'G7':
+            configured_hooks = out.strip().decode() if record['exit_code'] == 0 else None
+            assert record['exit_code'] == 0 or (not out and not err)
+        elif command_id == 'G8':
+            hooks = Path(configured_hooks or out.strip().decode())
+            if not hooks.is_absolute():
+                hooks = DELIVERY / hooks
+            assert hooks.is_dir() and not hooks.is_symlink()
+            active = [str(hooks / n) for n in ('pre-commit', 'prepare-commit-msg', 'commit-msg', 'post-commit', 'pre-push', 'post-rewrite')
+                      if (hooks / n).exists() and os.access(hooks / n, os.X_OK)]
+            assert not active, ('active hook requires new plan', active)
+    save(I / 'preflight.json', {'status': 'ALL_INITIAL_GATES_VALID', 'target_before': target_before,
+                               'main_index': main_index, 'main_status_before': main_before,
+                               'current_owned': frozen['sources'], 'checks_count': len(checks),
+                               'all_match': True, 'hooks_path': str(hooks), 'active_hooks': active})
+    save(D / 'input-check.json', {'status': 'ROOT_INPUTS_AND_ACTUAL_GIT_PREFLIGHT_VALID',
+                                 'checks': checks, 'selected_files': 740, 'aliases_resolved': 206,
+                                 'protected': 53, 'dependencies_both_roots': 50, 'all_valid': True})
+    save(D / 'root-activation.json', {'status': 'ACTIVATED_FINITE_R153_ONLY',
+                                     'time_utc': now(), 'actor': 'ROOT',
+                                     'plan_md': pin(D / 'plan.md'), 'plan_json': pin(D / 'plan.json'),
+                                     'input_check': pin(D / 'input-check.json'),
+                                     'preflight': pin(I / 'preflight.json'),
+                                     'new_product_or_review_budget': 0, 'retry_budget': 0,
+                                     'acceptance_not_yet_decided': True})
+    print(json.dumps({'phase': 'input', 'all_valid': True, 'checks': len(checks),
+                      'target_existing': sum(x is not None for x in target_before.values()),
+                      'target_existing_identical_static': sum(target_before[x['relative_path']] is not None and
+                           target_before[x['relative_path']]['sha256'] == x['sha256'] for x in selected.values()),
+                      'protected': 53, 'dependencies': 50}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+def manifest_phase():
+    assert json.loads((D / 'update-report.json').read_text())['allowlist_equal']
+    selected = json.loads((D / 'selected-manifest.json').read_text())
+    rows = []
+    for x in selected['files']:
+        rows.append({**expected(x['path'], x), 'relative_path': x['relative_path'], 'role': x['role']})
+    nonself = {str(D / n) for n in ('payload-index.json', 'delivery-paths.txt')}
+    paths = sorted({x['path'] for x in rows} | set(PLAN['payload']['exact_additional_paths']))
+    assert len(paths) == 759
+    for p in PLAN['payload']['exact_additional_paths']:
+        if p not in nonself:
+            rows.append({**pin(p), 'relative_path': relative(p), 'role': 'R153-derived-or-updated-status'})
+    assert len(rows) == 757 and len({x['relative_path'] for x in rows}) == 757
+    index = {'status': 'EXACT_SELECTED_PAYLOAD_NOT_FULL_REMOTE_REPRODUCTION',
+             'files': sorted(rows, key=lambda x: x['relative_path']), 'total_paths': 759,
+             'self_hash_exclusions': sorted(nonself), 'aliases': selected['omitted_same_bytes'],
+             'exclusions': PLAN['payload']['exclusions'], 'git_delivery': 'PENDING_ACTUAL_COMMIT_AND_PUSH'}
+    save(D / 'payload-index.json', index)
+    rels = sorted(relative(p) for p in paths)
+    write_bytes(D / 'delivery-paths.txt', ('\n'.join(rels) + '\n').encode())
+    write_bytes(I / 'delivery-paths.nul', b'\0'.join(x.encode() for x in rels) + b'\0')
+    all_rows = payload_records()
+    print(json.dumps({'phase': 'manifest', 'count': len(all_rows), 'bytes': sum(x['bytes'] for x in all_rows),
+                      'payload_index': pin(D / 'payload-index.json'), 'paths': pin(D / 'delivery-paths.txt')}, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+def copy_phase():
+    import shutil
+    pf = json.loads((I / 'preflight.json').read_text())
+    rows = payload_records()
+    for x in rows:
+        expected(x['path'], x)
+        target = DELIVERY / x['relative_path']
+        old = pf['target_before'][x['relative_path']]
+        if old is None:
+            assert not target.exists() and not target.is_symlink()
+        else:
+            expected(target, old)
+    out, _, _ = git('G1')
+    assert out.strip().decode() == BASE
+    copied = []
+    for x in rows:
+        target = DELIVERY / x['relative_path']
+        safe_parent(target, DELIVERY)
+        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        shutil.copyfile(x['path'], target)
+        os.chmod(target, x['mode'])
+        copied.append(expected(target, x))
+    deps = json.loads((D / 'dependency-preparation.json').read_text())
+    for x in deps['dependencies']:
+        expected(ROOT / x['path'], x['primary'])

+from pathlib import Path
+import base64
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import stat
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path('/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall')
+D = ROOT / 'artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round153-p6-stage-a-finite-git-delivery-20261012'
+I = D / 'implementation'
+DELIVERY = Path('/home/ningyd/.codex/worktrees/t12-p1-delivery/BIGsmall')
+BASE = 'cb59be66fe281d7ee2c1ca90bc803c3b80f37c76'
+PLAN = json.loads((D / 'plan.json').read_text())
+SPECS = {x['id']: x for x in PLAN['git_budget']['commands']}
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+def pin(p):
+    p = Path(p)
+    assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(), str(p)
+    b = p.read_bytes()
+    return {'path': str(p), 'bytes': len(b), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)}
+
+def expected(p, record):
+    a = pin(p)
+    assert all(a[k] == record[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')), (str(p), a, record)
+    if 'mode' in record:
+        assert a['mode'] == record['mode'], (str(p), 'mode')
+    return a
+
+def save(p, obj):
+    p = Path(p)
+    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with p.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+def write_bytes(p, b):
+    p = Path(p)
+    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with p.open('xb') as f:
+        f.write(b)
+
+def relative(p):
+    p = Path(p)
+    r = p.relative_to(ROOT)
+    assert str(r) and not any(x in ('.', '..') for x in r.parts)
+    assert '\x00' not in str(r) and '\n' not in str(r)
+    return str(r)
+
+def safe_parent(p, root):
+    p = Path(p)
+    p.relative_to(root)
+    assert not root.is_symlink()
+    for q in (p, *p.parents):
+        if q == root:
+            break
+        assert not q.is_symlink(), str(q)
+        if q != p and q.exists():
+            assert q.is_dir(), str(q)
+
+def git(command_id, argv=None, stdin=None, allowed=(0,)):
+    spec = SPECS[command_id]
+    gd = I / 'git'
+    gd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    ordinal = next((n for n in range(1, spec['max_runs'] + 1)
+                    if not (gd / f'{command_id}-{n}.invocation.json').exists()), None)
+    assert ordinal is not None, ('budget exhausted', command_id)
+    args = list(argv or spec['argv'])
+    prefix = gd / f'{command_id}-{ordinal}'
+    invocation = {'id': command_id, 'ordinal': ordinal, 'argv': args,
+                  'cwd': spec['cwd'], 'start_utc': now(), 'stdin_bytes': len(stdin or b'')}
+    if stdin is not None:
+        write_bytes(str(prefix) + '.stdin.bin', stdin)
+        invocation['stdin_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(stdin).hexdigest()
+    save(str(prefix) + '.invocation.json', invocation)
+    result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=spec['cwd'], input=stdin, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+    write_bytes(str(prefix) + '.stdout.txt', result.stdout)
+    write_bytes(str(prefix) + '.stderr.txt', result.stderr)
+    record = {**invocation, 'end_utc': now(), 'exit_code': result.returncode,
+              'stdout': pin(str(prefix) + '.stdout.txt'), 'stderr': pin(str(prefix) + '.stderr.txt')}
+    save(str(prefix) + '.result.json', record)
+    assert result.returncode in allowed, ('actual Git failure preserved', command_id, ordinal, result.returncode)
+    return result.stdout, result.stderr, record
+
+def entries(b):
+    parts = b.split(b'\0')
+    result = []
+    n = 0
+    while n < len(parts) and parts[n]:
+        item = parts[n].decode('utf-8')
+        xy, path = item[:2], item[3:]
+        other = None
+        if 'R' in xy or 'C' in xy:
+            n += 1
+            other = parts[n].decode('utf-8')
+        result.append({'status': xy, 'path': path, 'other': other})
+        n += 1
+    return result
+
+def payload_records():
+    index = json.loads((D / 'payload-index.json').read_text())
+    rows = index['files'] + [dict(pin(D / n), relative_path=relative(D / n), role='nonselfreferential-index') for n in ('payload-index.json', 'delivery-paths.txt')]
+    assert len(rows) == 759
+    return sorted(rows, key=lambda x: x['relative_path'])
+

+# R153 Stage A 有限 Git 交付 Implementation Plan
+
+> **For agentic workers:** 使用 superpowers:executing-plans 按本计划逐门执行；既定 ROOT 负责元数据与交付，不另派产品实施者。
+
+**Goal:** 将已冻结的 P6 Stage A 六源码及有限审计材料交付到既有研发分支，并由 ROOT 作限定软件验收。
+**Architecture:** 冻结静态清单与明确派生路径分离；先核终审和依赖，再保存受控状态更新，最后精确复制、暂存、提交和非强制推送。真实 Git 身份收据在提交外本地保存，避免自引用。
+**Tech Stack:** .venv/bin/python 标准库 bytes/hash/JSON/XML 与有限 Git；不调用产品。
+**Spec:** R113 A / R127 G1–G4 / R134 S-C-F / R151 disposition；精确路径与 SHA 在本轮 selected-manifest.json 及 plan.json。
+
+## 已核事实与边界
+
+实际规划者为 gpt-6-astra，代理 /root/astra_status_plan。R152 独立终审已完成，限定 LEASE_FOUNDATION_WITH_LEGACY_UTC_VETO 内 Critical/Important/Minor 均无已确认问题；24/24 只读额度已耗用。终审 JSON SHA db83f79f83f9fd50e56b965949a913da90f7c485776c16f15aa75e7c812b5bf4，外部 authority.files 实为15项，加该 JSON 共16文件。本计划不是 ROOT 已验收记录，也不授予产品变更。
+
+四份实际运行组成40个唯一通过节点：原 GREEN20 保留19PASS1FAIL，R147 修正 foreign 单例1PASS、原 new19 19PASS、R141 CPU positive1PASS；绝非一次40运行。静态证明只支持 R145 类型变更与 R147 夹具变更的有限证据沿用，不等于新增行为运行。正链调用原 episode 后仅注入六 flags，22自然文件 hash 匹配，物理量、模型、动作证据仍为零。精确最终 COMMIT 后失确认故障没有实际运行。B9 公开确认与 SQL 历史区别明确未解决；B/C/D、完整P6、native/physics/actual/formal 均不提升。
+
+740个既存文件19,732,316字节已逐项核对，另外50条两树依赖及6条交付底座共846项全匹配。静态清单保存206个同字节省略映射，排除9个额外历史源码副本；不可将清单或源索引称完整远端复现包。原失败、旧摘要与真实捕获缺口均保留。规划期 Git/产品命令均0。
+
+## Global Constraints / Review Focus
+
+- 主树保持原 dirty 状态，禁止 reset/stash/checkout/rebase/clean；主树 index 不写。
+- 交付底座必须在真实前置门复核：分支 codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery，本地/上游/实时远端均 cb59be66fe281d7ee2c1ca90bc803c3b80f37c76，工作树与暂存区干净。该值此前仅已报告，规划未运行 Git。
+- dependency-preparation.json 的50依赖逐文件一致，六 owned 底座分别符合 R113 四旧文件与两新文件不存在；漂移不自动扩产品范围。
+- 防并发覆盖：受控三文件写前保存 before 并即时复核；复制前与提交前重新核 HEAD，推送前核实时远端。
+- 防额外载荷：仅740静态路径加 plan.json 列出的19精确额外路径，共759路径；拒绝 symlink、gitlink、路径穿越、额外文件、删除和重命名。
+- 防验收夸大：B9、legacy UTC veto、CPU注入、四run与原失败必须在 ROOT acceptance 与新增当前状态段显式存在。
+- 防自引用：最终 payload-index 不给自己和 delivery-paths.txt 写 SHA；两者真实 SHA 由提交外 precommit/postpush 收据绑定。提交内不写本提交未来 SHA。
+- 防隐式测试：不执行 hooks、AST/import/compile/collect/static/pytest/SQL/probe；遇活动提交 hook 停止，不用 --no-verify。
+- 新失败先保存并交下一轮 genuine Astra；不复用或重置任何已耗产品/终审预算。
+

+- [ ] 当前六源码、全部R153提交文件及三状态文档的严格 diff --check 必须 exit0。出现新问题停止，不运行 formatter 修补。

+## Task 4 — 正常提交、推送与提交外收据
+

+- [ ] 实时远端仍base才正常非force push 一次。不得把并发新head静默当作新基线。
+- [ ] 本地HEAD、上游SHA与实时远端SHA必须同为刚创建commit；交付树干净，主树index与无关dirty原件保留。
+- [ ] 保存本地 postpush-receipt.json，记录真实命令原件、最终路径数与字节数、三SHA、selected包边界。此文件与Git日志不再追加到当前提交，不产生第二次提交或自引用。

+精确 argv、时序及次数见 plan.json.git_budget：Git最多28次（含前后读取、一次stage/commit/push），产品/新终审/重试额度均0。core.hooksPath未配置exit1，以及全历史载荷空白检查的已逐项匹配诊断，是预定义观察结果；其他意外失败都保留并停。元数据不能代替真实Git交付；Git成功也不能提升研究/物理验收。本轮仅规划，等待 ROOT 实际核对与激活。

+from pathlib import Path
+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import stat
+import subprocess
+
+ROOT = Path('/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall')
+D = ROOT / 'artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round154-p6-delivery-head-diagnostic-recovery-20261012'
+I = D / 'implementation'
+DELIVERY = Path('/home/ningyd/.codex/worktrees/t12-p1-delivery/BIGsmall')
+PLAN = json.loads((D / 'plan.json').read_text())
+SPECS = {x['id']: x for x in PLAN['commands']}
+HEAD = PLAN['facts']['observed_HEAD']
+
+def pin(p):
+    p = Path(p)
+    assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(), str(p)
+    b = p.read_bytes()
+    return {'path': str(p), 'bytes': len(b), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)}
+
+def save(p, x):
+    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with p.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps(x, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+def raw(p, b):
+    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with p.open('xb') as f:
+        f.write(b)
+
+def git(cid, args=None, allowed=(0,)):
+    spec = SPECS[cid]
+    prefix = I / 'git' / cid
+    inv = {'id': cid, 'argv': args or spec['argv'], 'cwd': spec['cwd'], 'start_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
+    save(Path(str(prefix) + '.invocation.json'), inv)
+    r = subprocess.run(inv['argv'], cwd=inv['cwd'], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+    raw(Path(str(prefix) + '.stdout.txt'), r.stdout)
+    raw(Path(str(prefix) + '.stderr.txt'), r.stderr)
+    result = {**inv, 'end_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'exit_code': r.returncode,
+              'stdout': pin(str(prefix) + '.stdout.txt'), 'stderr': pin(str(prefix) + '.stderr.txt')}
+    save(Path(str(prefix) + '.result.json'), result)
+    assert r.returncode in allowed, ('unexpected actual Git exit', cid, r.returncode)
+    return r.stdout, result
+
+def main():
+    assert json.loads((D / 'root-activation.json').read_text())['status'] == 'ACTIVATED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY'
+    checks = []
+    def compare(p, expected):
+        actual = pin(p)
+        valid = all(actual[k] == expected[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')) and ('mode' not in expected or actual['mode'] == expected['mode'])
+        checks.append({'actual': actual, 'expected': expected, 'valid': valid})
+    for x in PLAN['inputs']:
+        compare(x['path'], x)
+    oldplan = json.loads(Path(PLAN['transitive_inputs']['R153_plan']).read_text())
+    for x in oldplan['inputs']:
+        compare(x['path'], x)
+    selected = json.loads(Path(PLAN['transitive_inputs']['static_payload']).read_text())
+    for x in selected['files']:
+        compare(x['path'], x)
+    deps = json.loads(Path(PLAN['transitive_inputs']['dependency_and_owned_baseline']).read_text())
+    for x in deps['dependencies']:
+        compare(ROOT / x['path'], x['primary'])
+        compare(DELIVERY / x['path'], x['delivery'])
+    baseline_checks = []
+    for x in deps['owned_delivery_baseline']:
+        p = DELIVERY / x['path']
+        if x['expected_new']:
+            baseline_checks.append({'path': str(p), 'expected_absent': True, 'valid': not p.exists() and not p.is_symlink()})
+        else:
+            compare(p, x['delivery'])
+    index = Path(PLAN['transitive_inputs']['source_protected_authority'])
+    assert pin(index)['sha256'] == PLAN['transitive_inputs']['source_index_sha256']
+    ix = json.loads(index.read_text())
+    assert len(ix['sources']) == 6 and len(ix['protected']) == 53
+    for x in ix['sources']:
+        compare(x['source'], x)
+        compare(x['snapshot'], x)
+    for x in ix['protected']:
+        compare(x['path'], x)
+    review_path = next(x['path'] for x in oldplan['inputs'] if x['path'].endswith('/review/final-review.json'))
+    review = json.loads(Path(review_path).read_text())
+    for x in review['output_authority']['files']:
+        compare(x['path'], x)
+    assert all(x['valid'] for x in checks) and all(x['valid'] for x in baseline_checks)
+    outputs = {}
+    records = []
+    for cid in ('D01', 'D02', 'D03', 'D04', 'D05', 'D06', 'D07', 'D08', 'D09', 'D10', 'D11'):
+        out, rec = git(cid, allowed=(0, 1) if cid == 'D08' else (0,))
+        outputs[cid] = out
+        records.append(rec)
+        if cid == 'D01':
+            assert out.strip().decode() == HEAD
+        if cid == 'D02':
+            assert out.strip().decode() == 'codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery'
+        if cid == 'D03':
+            assert out.strip().decode() == 'refs/remotes/origin/codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery'
+    upstream = outputs['D04'].strip().decode()
+    live, remote_ref = outputs['D05'].strip().decode().split('\t')
+    assert remote_ref == 'refs/heads/codex/research-20261007-p1-delivery'
+    history = []
+    for line in outputs['D09'].decode().splitlines():
+        commit, parents, subject = line.split('\0', 2)
+        history.append({'commit': commit, 'parents': parents.split(), 'subject': subject})
+    parts = outputs['D10'].split(b'\0')
+    changed = []
+    n = 0
+    while n < len(parts) and parts[n]:
+        status = parts[n].decode()
+        path = parts[n + 1].decode()
+        n += 2
+        other = None
+        if status.startswith(('R', 'C')):
+            other = parts[n].decode()
+            n += 1
+        changed.append({'status': status, 'path': path, 'other': other})
+    binary = []
+    parts = outputs['D11'].split(b'\0')
+    n = 0
+    while n < len(parts) and parts[n]:
+        added, deleted, path = parts[n].decode().split('\t', 2)
+        n += 1
+        if not path:
+            path = parts[n].decode()
+            other = parts[n + 1].decode()
+            n += 2
+        if added == '-' or deleted == '-':
+            binary.append(path)
+    groups = {
+        'selected': {x['relative_path'] for x in selected['files']},
+        'dependencies': {x['path'] for x in deps['dependencies']},
+        'owned': {x['path'] for x in deps['owned_delivery_baseline']},
+        'protected': {str(Path(x['path']).relative_to(ROOT)) for x in ix['protected']},
+        'status_targets': {str(Path(x['path']).relative_to(ROOT)) for x in oldplan['metadata_update']['before']}
+    }
+    paths = sorted({x['path'] for x in changed} | {x['other'] for x in changed if x['other']})
+    overlaps = {k: sorted(set(paths) & v) for k, v in groups.items()}
+    unsafe = []
+    for p in paths:
+        q = Path(p)
+        safe_prefix = p.startswith(('docs/research/', 'artifacts/research/process/'))
+        unsafe_token = any(t in p.lower() for t in ('credential', 'secret', '.env', '/sdk/', '/weights/', '/fixture/', '/fixtures/', '.sqlite', '.db', '/sources/'))
+        if not safe_prefix or unsafe_token or q.suffix.lower() not in ('.md', '.json', '.txt', '.xml', '.patch', '.yaml', '.toml', '.csv') or p in binary:
+            unsafe.append(p)
+    ancestor = records[7]['exit_code'] == 0
+    reasons = []
+    if not ancestor:
+        reasons.append('oldbase is not ancestor')
+    if len(history) > 32:
+        reasons.append('history exceeds32')
+    if len(paths) > 64:
+        reasons.append('changedpaths exceed64')
+    if unsafe:
+        reasons.append('unsafe or unsupported text content')
+    diff_record = None
+    if not reasons:
+        diff, diff_record = git('D12', SPECS['D12']['argv'][:-1] + paths)
+        records.append(diff_record)
+        if len(diff) > 2 * 1024 * 1024:
+            reasons.append('actualdiff exceeds2MiB')
+    out, end_record = git('D13')
+    records.append(end_record)
+    assert out.strip().decode() == HEAD
+    if outputs['D06']:
+        reasons.append('delivery dirty')
+    if upstream != HEAD or live != HEAD:
+        reasons.append('local upstream/live remote not same observed HEAD')
+    if overlaps['owned'] or overlaps['dependencies'] or overlaps['protected']:
+        reasons.append('affected code/dependency/protected overlap needs new review')
+    result = {'status': 'READ_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE', 'observed_HEAD': HEAD,
+              'branch': outputs['D02'].strip().decode(), 'upstream': upstream, 'live_remote': live,
+              'clean': not outputs['D06'], 'oldbase_ancestor': ancestor,
+              'commit_raw': outputs['D07'].decode(), 'intervening_commits': history,
+              'changed': changed, 'overlaps': overlaps, 'unsafe': unsafe, 'binary': binary,
+              'diff_raw': diff_record['stdout'] if diff_record else None,
+              'checks': checks, 'checks_count': len(checks), 'all_valid': True,
+              'new_paths_absent_baseline_checks': baseline_checks,
+              'R153_derived_presence': [{'path': p, 'exists': Path(p).exists()} for p in oldplan['payload']['exact_additional_paths']],

+# R155 不相交新基线上的 Stage A 有限交付 Implementation Plan
+
+> **For agentic workers:** 使用 superpowers:executing-plans，沿既定 ROOT 元数据与交付方式执行；无产品实施授权。
+
+**Goal:** 在已查明的315fd基线上完成六源码与有限审计包交付，并由ROOT决定限定A软件验收。
+**Architecture:** 保留R153失败与R154诊断；显式处置无关文档全语义审查不属于本轮必要条件。采用新R155路径/助手/清单，逐门验收、复制、暂存与非强制推送。
+**Tech Stack:** .venv/bin/python标准库元数据/hash与有限Git，零产品执行。
+**Spec:** 本计划JSON精确输入、R113A/R127G1–G4/R134S-C-F/R151 disposition及R152独立终审。
+
+## 独立事实与 R154 不适用结论的处置
